keywords: Certiorari and Mandamus – Incorporated religious trust – Petitioner claiming resignation as trustee was tendered under duress and later withdrawn – Whether incorporation by Act of Parliament makes trustees amenable to writ jurisdiction – Public law/private law distinction – No statutory or public function affecting petitioner’s rights – Absence of sufficient public element – Judicial review unavailable – Approximately six-year delay following resignation also adverse to petitioner – Writ relief refused.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Board of Trustees of the Bhagavan Sri Sathya Sai Central Trust of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Act No. 38 of 2007 – sections 5 and 12.
